Is that safe? No, no.

Oh, my God. Yeah, get it out.
And then just make it look like...
Goddamn you, Charlie. Goddamn it, go.

Yes!
Why'd I hear a squeal? Oh, no, dude, why are you bleeding?

Come to me like a man! Talk about being tough all the time; can't even look me in the eyes.
Okay. How's this for shoes, Charlie?

Me? No, this was Mac's stupid plan.

Look, we can handle all of this, all right?

Oh, no, he wants a turkey burger.

Tell him you got the order wrong, just tell him you got the thing wrong. Oh, my God, what a stupid bitch. What a stupid bitch she is. Okay.

Okay? Okay?

That was nice. Have a wonderful day. Okay.
Okay. Guys, we got the highest grade! I didn't think we were gonna do it 'cause of the Dumpster, but, man, she got us the highest grade!

We passed the health inspection! Boo!

Yeah, we were excited about the airline miles thing.
Well, yeah, that's cool, too, but the health inspection was the whole thing, man! I pulled it off! It was like, "Here goes there!" I did the whole thing.
Uh, Charlie, come on. We always pass, okay? We never have a hard time passing. It's not a big deal. Nobody gives a shit. You didn't do anything that special.

episodes.title: The Gang Beats Boggs
episodes.summary: Mac oversees the gang while they compete to break Wade Boggs’ legendary beer drinking record.

episodes.title: The Gang Group Dates
episodes.summary: The gang gets into the online dating scene to expand their matchmaking potential.

episodes.title: Psycho Pete Returns
episodes.summary: When Psycho Pete, long lost member of the freight train, is released from the mental hospital, Dennis and Dee rush to get him recommitted while Charlie and Mac attempt to restore him to his former...

episodes.title: Charlie Work
episodes.summary: Charlie goes into overdrive when he's notified that the health inspector will be arriving that day. Meanwhile, the rest of the gang is trying to exploit a flaw in the air-miles reward system.

episodes.title: The Gang Spies Like U.S.
episodes.summary: Dennis and Mac enlist Dee to spy on the fish factory across the street, Charlie and Frank grow suspicious and decide to do some spying of their own. Written by David Hornsby; directed by Matt Shakman.

episodes.title: The Gang Misses the Boat
episodes.summary: The group separates from one another to find out who they are as individuals after another failed endeavor.

episodes.title: Mac Kills His Dad
episodes.summary: News surfaces about Mac's Dad, Luther, being a murder suspect. Mac goes into full "P.I." mode to clear his father of any wrong doing.

episodes.title: The Gang Goes on Family Fight
episodes.summary: When the gang appears on a nationally broadcasted game show, Dennis does his best to keep the gang’s weirdness under wraps.

episodes.title: Frank Retires
episodes.summary: Frank decides to retire; the foursome begin to plot and plan ways for each of them to take control of the bar.

episodes.title: Ass Kickers United: Mac and Charlie Join a Cult
episodes.summary: "Asskickers" isn't just a hot new way to work out; it's a way of life...and maybe a cult.
